messages:
ana: heads up — master CI is failing across multiple runners. nightly-inference-e2e and deploy-preview both erroring with KMS permission denied. noticed right after the 03:00 KMS key rotation.

ana: log snippet: 
```
ERROR: failed to decrypt secret 'service/infra/ci-token' : AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ci-runner is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abc-rotated-key
```

liam: ack. i'll take a look. can someone not rerun yet? want to try a bisect to see when it started.

jen: @liam fyi i force-rolled the KMS key last night per rotation policy at 02:45 — that was the only infra change in the window. did we update the CI role policy to include the new key alias?

mike: looks like the role policy references the old key id directly. the rotation created a new key id but kept the alias. if policies pin the id we break.

ana: huh — our deploy pipelines use the key id in the terraform state (see infra/keys.tf). i probably forgot to update the state after the rotation.

liam: ok step plan: 1) don't merge anything that touches infra until fixed, 2) run a bisect to isolate which commit triggered CI failures (likely the key rotation commit), 3) temp workaround: grant kms:Decrypt to ci-runner on alias/* or update role to refer to alias ARN, 4) patch terraform and apply.

jen: bisect request: can someone rerun just the failing job for the last 10 commits? i can watch and cancel if it becomes noisy. ci-bot can you enqueue reruns? :pray:

ci-bot: Requested reruns for job nightly-inference-e2e on commits: a1f4c2d, b2d5e3f, c3e6f4a — queued on runner group infra-shared.

mike: while reruns run — quick check: `aws kms list-aliases --key-id alias/ci-key` shows alias is pointing to `key/def-NEWID` now, terraform still references `key/abc-rotated-key` id.

liam: reruns show same AccessDenied for the first two commits, third commit (c3e6f4a) fails in a different test (flake). looks like bisect narrowed it to the rotation commit as suspected.

ana: i temporarily added a quick IAM statement to the ci-runner role granting `kms:Decrypt` on the alias ARN. applying now to unblock e2e. will revert after we patch TF properly.

jen: can you paste the policy you applied? want to replicate in staging.

ana: pasted: 
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/ci-key"]
}
```

mike: rerun results: ✅ nightly-inference-e2e is green after temporary policy change. deploy-preview still had an unrelated flaky test but not KMS.

liam: awesome. next actions: ana please open a quick PR to update infra/keys.tf and state to use alias rather than hard id + add a README note about rotation steps. jen can we also add an automation check to warn if terraform references raw key ids?

jen: yes — i'll add a tf-lint rule and a preapply hook to fail if `aws_kms_key` resources reference hardcoded legacy ids. creating issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/712

ops-bot: Reminder: rotated key `alias/ci-key` at 2026-03-17T02:45Z by jen.

ana: created PR #3421 to update tf and state — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3421. requesting review from @mike and @liam.

mike: reviewing now. small nit about state import command in the PR — i'll suggest an inline fix.

liam: thanks everyone. lesson: don't pin KMS by id in infra. also remind oncall to coordinate rotation windows with CI owners. closing thread once PR merges and we revert temp IAM change. :thumbsup:

ana: reverted the temporary IAM change after PR merged and applied — confirmed all pipelines green. closing.
